commitResults.messageTitle: Rename chatbot and add Level-0 greeting
commitResults.messageBody:
Rename the entry point and visible branding so the application
consistently identifies itself as Chatty. Print a structured greeting
and farewell to establish the Level-0 interaction.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add command echo and bye handling
commitResults.messageBody:
Keep reading user input so Chatty can echo commands instead of exiting
after its greeting. Handle bye separately to end the conversation with a
clear farewell.

Store task descriptions during each Chatty session so users can build
a simple list without persistence. Number tasks in insertion order when
the list command is entered.

Represent each task as an object so its description and completion
status stay together. Support listing, marking, and unmarking tasks, and
document the commands in the user guide.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add todo deadline and event tasks
commitResults.messageBody:
Parse the three Level-4 task formats while preserving date and time
values as user-entered text. Display task type icons, timing details, and
the updated task count, and document each command.

Move type-specific display data into Todo, Deadline, and Event
subclasses. Keep common status behavior in Task and use polymorphism so
the task list does not need type-specific branching.
